en.headline: Customs seizes 8kg of cannabis at airport, two men arrested
en.dek: Two incoming passengers from Bangkok were arrested on Thursday after officers found about 8 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds valued at roughly HK$1.7 million in their luggage.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two separate drug trafficking cases involving incoming passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday.

In the first case, a 30-year-old mainland man arriving from Bangkok was found with about 5 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds inside his carry-on suitcase. In the second, a 36-year-old mainland man also arriving from Bangkok had about 3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in his luggage. Both men were arrested.

Customs estimated the total market value of the seized cannabis at about HK$1.7 million. Investigations are continuing, and the department said it would step up enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis.
The cases were disclosed in an official press release issued on Thursday evening.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲8公斤大麻花 兩名男子被捕
zh.dek: 兩名從曼谷抵港的入境乘客周四被截獲，行李內藏約8公斤懷疑大麻花，市值約170萬港元。
body: 香港海關周四在香港國際機場截獲兩宗涉及入境乘客的販毒案件。
首宗案件中，一名30歲內地男子從曼谷抵港，海關人員在其手提行李內發現約5公斤懷疑大麻花。第二宗則涉及另一名36歲從曼谷抵港的內地男子，其行李內藏約3公斤懷疑大麻花。兩人均被拘捕。
海關估計檢獲的大麻花總市值約170萬港元。調查仍在進行，署方表示會透過情報分析加強打擊販毒活動。
案件詳情由海關於周四晚間的新聞稿公布。
